title: Glowing toy block
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="55" r="38" fill="#2a1a4a" opacity="0.35"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="55" r="30" fill="#3d2a6b" opacity="0.3"/>

  <!-- Block shadow/glow base -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="26" ry="6" fill="#5533aa" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Top face of the block (lighter, glowing) -->
  <polygon points="50,22 78,34 50,46 22,34" fill="#ffe84d" stroke="#fff5a8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Left face (medium) -->
  <polygon points="22,34 50,46 50,76 22,64" fill="#ff9933" stroke="#ffcc66" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Right face (darker) -->
  <polygon points="78,34 50,46 50,76 78,64" fill="#cc5500" stroke="#ff9933" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Letter "A" on left face -->
  <polygon points="33,42 30,58 34,58 35,54 39,54 40,58 44,58 41,42" fill="#fff2b0"/>
  <polygon points="35.5,50 38.5,50 37,44" fill="#ff9933"/>

  <!-- Letter "B" on right face (simplified as glowing dots/shapes) -->
  <circle cx="60" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#fff2b0"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="56" r="2.5" fill="#fff2b0"/>
  <rect x="60" y="60" width="7" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#fff2b0"/>

  <!-- Studs on top face (classic block circles) -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="32" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#ffdd33" stroke="#fff5a8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="34" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#ffdd33" stroke="#fff5a8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="32" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#ffdd33" stroke="#fff5a8" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Top studs shine -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="31" rx="2.5" ry="1.2" fill="#fffde0" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="33" rx="2.5" ry="1.2" fill="#fffde0" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="31" rx="2.5" ry="1.2" fill="#fffde0" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Sparkles around the block -->
  <g fill="#ffe84d">
    <polygon points="14,26 15.5,22 17,26 21,27 17,28 15.5,32 14,28 10,27" />
    <polygon points="84,20 85,17 86,20 89,20.5 86,21 85,24 84,21 81,20.5" />
    <polygon points="86,70 87,67 88,70 91,70.5 88,71 87,74 86,71 83,70.5" />
    <polygon points="12,64 13,61.5 14,64 16.5,64.5 14,65 13,67.5 12,65 9.5,64.5" />
  </g>
</svg>
